emma: Drafting a tiny Optimize Toolkit FAQ: "Micro-batching + KV prefetch with quantized models". Needs: 1 short decision para, 2 snippets (Node + Go), and a 1-line migration note. Can someone review anchors and SDK param names?

rafael: Happy to review. Keep snippets <10 lines and use placeholders for model names. I'll sanity-check the Go snippet.

priya: I'll own Node snippet and confirm JS SDK field names (camelCase vs snake_case). Also will check quant-profiles anchor. I think the stable anchor is #quantization-guidance.

emma: Draft Node snippet (priya please sanity-check):

```js
// pseudocode - redwood-js
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const r = await c.generate({ model: '<model-name>', maxTokens: 64, batching: { type: 'micro', maxBatchTokens: 256 }, kvPrefetch: false })
console.log(await r.text())
```

priya: Looks good; our SDK uses camelCase so this matches. I'll run a quick lint. Add one line noting: "turn kvPrefetch on for large-batch long-seq workloads".

rafael: Go snippet (quick draft):

```go
// pseudocode - redwood-go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req := redwood.GenerationRequest{Model: "<model-name>", MaxTokens: 48, Batching: redwood.Micro{MaxBatchTokens: 256}, KVPrefetch: false}
resp, _ := client.Generate(req)
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

rafael: I'll test this against a q4 quant build and report any API mismatches. Quick perf note: micro-batching improves throughput under concurrency but can hurt 95th latency for single short requests.

emma: Migration blurb: "Older examples defaulted to kv-prefetch on; with quant kernels that can raise peak RAM—explicitly set kvPrefetch and benchmark representative workloads."

docs-bot: Reminder: include samplegen metadata (opt/microbatch-quant) and run code-block linting per CONTRIBUTING.md.

priya: I'll confirm the quant anchor and add the cross-ref to /optimize/quant-profiles.md#quantization-guidance.

emma: I'll open a WIP PR and tag @rafael @priya. Aim to merge after quick checks. :rocket:
